name: seongho-ops
description: Guides design, debugging, verification, TDD, measured performance, and Argo CD operations; routes operational CLIs; opens protected previews; and packages Seongho's port cleanup utility.

interface.shortDescription: Guide development work and Argo CD operations; route operational CLIs; open previews; and provide k.
interface.longDescription: Seongho Ops provides lightweight, implicitly invocable brainstorming, systematic debugging, completion verification, test-driven development, performance engineering, and Argo CD operations skills. It separates Kubernetes, Argo CD project, and Argo CD Application RBAC; selects the correct authenticated local CLI; securely opens protected Vercel previews in the Codex browser; and bundles the k command for force-stopping processes that own explicitly requested local ports.
defaultPrompt: Use the correct local CLI for this operational task.
Diagnose this CLI authentication failure safely.
Open this protected Vercel preview in the Codex browser.
Free this local port with the bundled k command.
Verify this work before reporting completion.
Debug this failure from evidence before proposing a fix.
Check the exact Argo CD Application capability without conflating Kubernetes or project RBAC.
Implement this code change with test-driven development.
Measure this bottleneck and meet its performance target without guessing.
